title: Erdős 396 · central binomial and descending factorials
statement:
open Nat in
theorem erdos_396 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, descFactorial n (k + 1) ∣ centralBinom n := by
  sorry
informal: For every k, is there an n such that n(n−1)⋯(n−k) divides the central binomial coefficient C(2n, n)?

formalConjectures.pinnedForm: answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ k, ∃ n, descFactorial n (k + 1) ∣ centralBinom n
formalConjectures.upstreamForm: ∀ k, ∃ n, descFactorial n (k + 1) ∣ centralBinom n
